title.en: What Kind of Seatmate Are You on a Group Trip?
title.zh: 同行一段路：你是哪种邻座？

description.en: Six imagined shared-journey choices about conversation, personal space and the little practical arrangements that make a seat comfortable.
description.zh: 六次想象同行选择，围绕聊天、个人空间与让座位舒服的小安排，发现你在这段旅程中的邻座画像。

introduction.en: Picture a comfortable fictional group journey with ordinary shared seats. You choose how to use the time and space beside another person. No result ranks sociability or predicts travel compatibility; a seatmate can want different things on different days.
introduction.zh: 想象一段舒适虚构团体旅程，大家坐普通共用座位。你选择怎样使用与他人相邻的时间空间。结果不排社交高低，也不预测旅行匹配；同一个邻座每天也会想要不同。

focus.en: Negotiating a shared seat through a gentle conversation, an undemanding parallel activity or practical space agreements.
focus.zh: 通过轻松交流、无要求的并行活动或实际空间约定，共用一段邻座。

prompt.en: You settle beside another traveler. You first…
prompt.zh: 在另一位旅客身旁坐下，你先……

label.en: Offer a brief hello and see whether they want to talk.
label.zh: 简短招呼，看看对方是否想聊。

label.en: Settle into your own quiet activity while leaving company possible.
label.zh: 安顿自己的安静活动，也保留作伴可能。

label.en: Check where shared bags and small items can go.
label.zh: 确认共用包袋与小物可放哪里。

prompt.en: The group has a long uneventful stretch. You prefer…
prompt.zh: 有一长段平静路程，你更愿……

label.en: Reading or looking out together without needing constant conversation.
label.zh: 各自读书或一起看窗外，不必持续说话。

label.en: A relaxed exchange about something both people choose.
label.zh: 聊一件双方愿意谈的轻松事。

label.en: Making the shared space easier to use before relaxing.
label.zh: 先让共用空间好用，再放松。

prompt.en: A neighbor starts a conversation while you are reading. You…
prompt.zh: 邻座在你读书时开口，你会……

label.en: Name a comfortable time to chat after a short pause.
label.zh: 说明稍停后方便聊的一段时间。

label.en: Explain the small space or item issue if that is why they asked.
label.zh: 若对方为小空间或物件开口，先说清安排。

label.en: Say kindly that you would like quiet for a while.
label.zh: 温和说明想安静一会儿。

prompt.en: Several people want to use the same little shared table. You…
prompt.zh: 几个人都想用同一张小共用桌，你会……

label.en: Agree on a simple turn or space split.
label.zh: 约一个简单轮次或空间划分。

label.en: Choose a table-free activity for yourself this stretch.
label.zh: 这段自己先选不用桌面的活动。

label.en: Ask what each person is hoping to do and talk through a fit.
label.zh: 问各自想做什么，聊出一种搭配。

prompt.en: Someone asks whether silence means the journey is going badly. You…
prompt.zh: 有人问，安静是否说明同行不愉快，你会……

label.en: Say quiet company can be a complete way to share the stretch.
label.zh: 说明安静作伴也可以是完整同行方式。

label.en: Offer a light conversation if they would enjoy one.
label.zh: 若对方愿意，提供一段轻松交流。

label.en: Ask whether any specific practical discomfort needs changing.
label.zh: 问是否有具体不舒服的安排要改。

prompt.en: What detail makes this neighboring seat feel good?
prompt.zh: 什么细节让这段邻座舒服？

label.en: We could talk and stop without making either awkward.
label.zh: 想聊可聊，想停可停，两者都不尴尬。
小型共用空间预期清楚。

label.en: We could each do our own thing without feeling absent.
label.zh: 可以各做各的，也不觉得谁缺席。

summary.en: Your shared journey makes room for a little conversation that both people can choose. An opening and a pause can coexist. The portrait describes the exchange you selected in this scene rather than assigning a fixed level of sociability.
summary.zh: 你的同行给双方可选择的小交流留位置。开口与停顿可以并存。画像描述这个场景里所选交流，不分配固定社交程度。

example.en: You might ask about a book a neighbor has chosen to mention, then happily return to the window when the conversation reaches a natural pause.
example.zh: 你可能问邻座主动提到的书，再在自然停顿时自在转回窗外。

strength.en: A modest invitation to talk can make shared time feel personal while leaving the other person free to choose how much to contribute.
strength.zh: 适度邀请聊天能让共处时间有个人联系，也让对方自由选择聊多少。

tradeoff.en: A friendly opening is still optional for the other person. Treating short replies as permission to pause keeps the exchange comfortable.
tradeoff.zh: 友好开口对另一人仍可选。把简短回应也视为可停顿的信号，交流更舒服。

experiment.en: Offer one easy conversation opening in a willing shared moment, then leave an equally easy pause rather than trying to keep every minute filled.
experiment.zh: 在愿意的共处时刻开一个轻松话题，也留同样容易的停顿，不必填满每一分钟。

summary.en: Your seatmate portrait enjoys being nearby without requiring a continuous exchange. Separate pages or a shared view can hold company quietly. This ending does not infer avoidance, loneliness or a general preference to be alone.
summary.zh: 你的邻座画像享受靠近，却不要求连续交流。各自书页或共同景象，也可安静作伴。结局不推断回避、孤独或普遍偏爱独处。

example.en: Two friends might read different books on the same journey and occasionally share a sentence, without needing to turn the whole trip into a conversation.
example.zh: 两位朋友可以一路读不同的书，偶尔分享一句，不必把整段路都变对话。

strength.en: Parallel activity gives companionship a low-demand form and can let different energy levels coexist within the same small space.
strength.zh: 并行活动给作伴一种低要求形式，也让不同精力状态在小空间并存。

tradeoff.en: Quiet can be misread if a shared expectation is never named. One simple statement of preference can prevent unnecessary guessing.
tradeoff.zh: 共同预期从不说明时，安静也可能被误读。一句简单偏好说明，能减少无谓猜测。

experiment.en: When sharing quiet time with someone willing, name that you enjoy their company and also want a little independent activity. Ask what would suit them.
experiment.zh: 与愿意的人共享安静时，说明喜欢作伴，也想做一点独立活动，再问对方怎样合适。

title.zh: 共用空间说得清的邻座

summary.en: Your journey becomes comfortable through small shared arrangements that do not have to be guessed. A table turn or a place for bags can matter more than another activity. The ending does not appoint you manager of the whole trip.
summary.zh: 你的旅程通过不用猜的小共用安排变舒服。桌面轮次或包袋位置，也许比再加活动更重要。结局不任命你管理整段旅途。

example.en: You might agree where each person’s small items can sit before spreading a map across a shared table during a leisurely outing.
example.zh: 轻松外出时，你可能先约好各自小物放哪，再把地图摊上共用桌。

strength.en: A clear arrangement can reduce accidental interruptions and make a limited shared space feel easier for both people to use.
strength.zh: 清楚安排能减少无意打扰，让有限共用空间对双方都更好用。

tradeoff.en: Arranging every detail can become fussy when no one is actually uncomfortable. Checking the one real constraint may be enough.
tradeoff.zh: 没人实际不舒服时，安排每个细节也会琐碎。核清一个真实限制，可能已够。

experiment.en: For one small shared space, ask what is getting in the way and agree on one simple change. Leave the other details flexible.
experiment.zh: 面对一个小共用空间，问什么确实碍事，再约一项简单变化。其他细节保持灵活。
